notes: Fixes the reported same-module case, but parent/child precedence is still decided statically before expansion, so it drops a child's dynamic (for_each) import block entirely or lets a child overwrite a parent when both resolve to the same instance; it also leaves a mostly unused map-returning API in place and edits CHANGELOG.md directly.

Fixes the reported root-module case and keeps parent/child blocks with differing static targets. However, it decides override at config time by statically parsing `to` expressions, so a dynamic (for_each) child block is dropped wholesale when the parent also targets that resource. It also leaves no instance-level dedupe in expansion, keeps a now-redundant dedup API, and edits CHANGELOG.md directly.

Fixes the same-module case, but parent/child dedup still works at the ConfigResource level, so a child block targeting a different instance than a parent block is silently dropped; that is the same class of bug in the module case.

Simple and focused fix that keeps multiple same-module blocks, which resolves the reported root-only case. It still drops every child-module block whenever a parent block targets the same ConfigResource, even for a different instance, because it dedupes by resource rather than by instance at expansion time.

Matches the reference: returns every import statement and moves parent-over-child precedence to per-instance dedup in expandResourceImports, with good regression tests for for_each, count, and cross-module cases.

Matches the reference approach: it returns all import statements undeduplicated and applies parent-over-child precedence per resource instance in expandResourceImports. Tests cover for_each, count, and the parent/child module case.
